study: Aberrant DNA hypermethylation of CpG islands occurs frequently throughout the genome in human colorectal cancer (CRC) -- MCTA-Seq plasma cohort (Kang et al.)
why_this_record: The GEO survey said this series carries per-sample stage labels and per-sample methylation matrices but did not verify either against the downloaded files. This artifact is the verification: every number below was measured from the deposited supplementary files and the GEO sample records, not quoted from the series description.

design.quote: The methylated CpG tandems amplification and sequencing (MCTA-Seq) method was applied to 33 tumor tissues, 33 adjacent tumor tissues and plasma samples from 147 CRC patients and 134 controls in which 5 from the CRC patients and 2 from the control subjects failed to pass a quality control value and were excluded from further analysis.

stage_labels.note: The stage label is on the cancer plasma samples only; the control plasma samples carry no stage label.

caveats: This is a METHYLATION cohort: the matrices carry methylation values at CpG loci, not fragment-length distributions, so it cannot be scored with this repository's fragmentomics model.
The plasma matrix is split across two deposited files (268 columns in the 'dup' file and 6 in the 'nodup' file); together they cover every plasma sample in the series.

The per-sample supplementary files in GEO are NONE -- the matrices are combined per series into these three files, so the per-sample view requires splitting the columns by the sample names in the header row.

The header row of the plasma matrices carries its sample names space-separated inside one tab field, while the data rows are tab-separated; a parser that splits the header on tabs alone will read one sample instead of 268.
